blocks.usage:
openconvert 0.1.0

USAGE
  openconvert convert <file>... -t <fmt>  do it, and write a receipt
  openconvert convert *.heic -t jpeg    many files, one summary
  openconvert convert <file> --trim 0:30-1:15
  openconvert convert <file> -t png --page 3   render page 3 (zero-based)
  openconvert convert <file> --remux      rewrap without re-encoding
  openconvert inspect <file>            what is this file, really?
  openconvert plan <file> -t <format>   what WOULD happen, without doing it
  openconvert batch <dir> -t <fmt>      many files, one journal; --resume to skip
  openconvert concat <out.mkv> <in...>  join Matroska files, losslessly
  openconvert models [list|get <id>|enable|disable|remove]
  openconvert convert <f> --remove-background  cut the subject out
  openconvert recipe save|load          pin a conversion, replay it later
  openconvert routes <from> <to>        print the route table for a pair
  openconvert formats                   every format we know

Times take SS, MM:SS or HH:MM:SS, with optional .fraction seconds.

`plan` is `convert` minus one call. The preview is the absence of
execute(), not a feature built beside it.
